scope: Private research comparison of baseline adapter versus research K=1 candidate; not a fixed-v1 capsule benchmark or provider qualification.

baseline.description: Existing HIP bitonic TOPK adapter with scratch and D2D index copy, invoked at K=1.

candidate.description: Research argmax: one 256-thread block per row, 2 KiB static shared memory, no caller scratch.

evidence.lock_release_note: Compile phase has no GPU lease or lock-release receipt.

analysis.sample_units: microseconds per launch; each sample is a batch of 100 launches
analysis.median_definition: Arithmetic mean of sorted samples at zero-based positions 9 and 10, separately for each provider, shape and trial.
analysis.ratio_definition: baseline_median_us / candidate_median_us; ratio greater than 1 means lower candidate median time. This is a ratio of medians, not a median of paired ratios.
verification: All compile and run receipt output byte counts and SHA-256 hashes verified against evidence files.
All three phases process-complete with return code 0 and no process failure.
Prefix before/after evidence hashes match, with physical_equal and semantic_equal true in all three phases.
Both measured runs diagnostic=false, empty stderr, preflight passed, exclusive GPU lease acquired and matching released receipt.
Both runs used the same compiled executable; shape, seed and input digest match across trials.
All 480 raw samples are finite and positive; all 24 provider medians recomputed exactly.
Both providers passed CPU correctness checks before and after timing for all six shapes in both trials.
limitations: Only six K=1 shapes and one deterministic distinct finite F32 input per shape on one gfx1151 device; no ties, NaNs or general-K qualification.
Two separate trials, without pooling, confidence intervals or broad workload claims.
Timing includes all provider stream work, baseline D2D index copy and possible host enqueue gaps; it is not pure kernel latency.
No rocPRIM or control comparison was measured.
Compile used loader diagnostics; both timing runs disabled diagnostics.
Preflight source hashes differ between trial1 and trial2; both receipt hashes are retained. The measured executable and launcher hashes match across trials.
Loaded library paths are observations; metadata coverage remains unknown and vendor authenticity unverified.
Receipt hashes identify external evidence; the large prefix evidence files and executable are not embedded in this portable artifact.

measurement.scope: private-research-only; not fixed-v1 or provider qualification
measurement.semantics: K=1 original column index of maximum value, finite F32 distinct values per row; CPU bit-value/index oracle; no tie/NaN/general-K qualification
measurement.timing_scope: HIP event batch elapsed / 100; all provider stream work including baseline D2D index copy and possible host enqueue gaps; excludes input transfer, validation, allocation, event creation
